title: SPINACH
instructions: Spinach must be thrown into boiling water, and when sufficiently cooked drained in a colander or cheesecloth, and chopped fine on a very clean board with a perfectly clean knife, then warmed in a saucepan; add salt,  butter and sugar to taste, and serve very hot and quickly. It should be trimmed with small pieces of fried bread around the dish.
